title: Conditional contrast inference and HMP evidence investigation
disposition_reason: The successor source already grades an observed logged-contrast target conditional on RT/instruction. This revision makes that target primary and retains HMP report reconstruction and stage interpretation as separate evidence audits. The complete programme exists as source, but authentic source admission, references and runtime/scientific qualification remain open.

scientific_target.question: Can retrospective EEG or a training-fitted HMP tool improve held-person logged-contrast prediction beyond RT/instruction, and which HMP stage interpretations remain supported after alternative timing explanations are examined?
scientific_target.known_answer: Primary: source logged contrast y=float(stimulus)/100 with0.025<y<1. Secondary numerical audits: independently recomputable HMP report cells and ordinary-versus-zero-gain model evidence. HMP event modes and stage names are not observed physiological answers.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original cleaned-epoch metadata joined privately to event_name/event_id/trigger mappings; source target mapping is documented but authentic values/aliases still need admission.
scientific_target.case_unit: Complete held-person retrospective trial panel for each matchedB/E/H/EH information view and frozen-program/investigator mode.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 26 participants, also used by NEURAL-003; trials, event counts and208prediction contexts are nested conditions, not additional cohorts.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Observed-target contrast prediction is retrospective conditional inference; finite-reference improvement is neither mutual information nor proof of a cognitive stage. HMP timing uncertainty is model-conditional.
exclusions: No neural stage ground truth from HMP modes, source effect signs or a reasoning-judge verdict.
No causal/pre-response claim: original cleaning/filtering and response-dependent crop are retained.
No whole-paper reproduction from2964report-cell agreement and no human-performance result from a proposed rubric.

inputs: B: logged RT in seconds, instruction and sample count; E adds all32original512Hz EEG channels on complete retained intervals.
H adds the exact outer-training-fitted HMP states/marginals/log-masses for4/5/6event counts; EH combines E and H. All training views include lawful training contrast labels.
Original source cleaning, filtering, response offset and eligibility remain retrospective; no downsampling/subsample substitution.
forbidden_inputs: Held stimulus/contrast, event_name/event_id/trigger, source path/epoch order, side/correctness fields, authenticated target digests or unrestricted FIF metadata.
Any reconstruction packet, notes, scores or fitted state crossing into protected prediction contexts; no cross-fold target transfer.
observation_contract.case_identity: Source-owned per-context opaque person/trial aliases with private bijective maps; identical retained trials must appear in every matched view. Authentic original roster and alias checks remain unexecuted.
observation_contract.split: All26 outer held-person folds, training on other25people; independent references use25 inner held-person losses. Supplied HMP fits see all outer-training EEG, so supervised inner readout diagnostics on those states are disclosed training-pool transductive analyses.
observation_contract.coverage: Complete26person support and all original retained trials;2modes×4views×26people=208prediction contexts. Separate reconstruction has2964report cells. Planned78HMP fits and312ordinary/zero evaluations are workload counts, not completed work or new tasks.

primary.name: participant-macro logged-contrast mean squared error
primary.aggregation: Mean squared fractional-contrast error within each held person, then equal mean over26people for each separate mode/view; paired difference against frozen behavior reference.
primary.rationale: Grades an observed experimental target in common units and matches the concrete successor scorer, while avoiding a manufactured physiological-stage answer key.

secondary: All26 paired person losses;100×sqrt(macroMSE) as percentage-point RMSE for display only.
Separate ordinary-minus-zero HMP per-trial log mass, marginals and count sensitivity with identical support/normalization.
Separate2964cell reconstruction agreement with source units/support/undefined patterns; no combined reconstruction/prediction leaderboard.
Evidence-linked scientific reasoning rubric only after all prediction seals; proposed blinded experts have no results yet.

comparators.name: behavior_reference_B
comparators.inputs: RT, instruction and deterministic sample count only.
comparators.procedure: Existing training-only nested-person selection among instruction-mean and nonlinear RT reference families; never select on outer labels.

comparators.name: neural_reference_N
comparators.inputs: The same behavior inputs plus full EEG feature families.
comparators.procedure: Existing matched selection includes B candidates so a behavioral fallback is valid; competence still requires actual complete reference execution.

comparators.name: HMP_zero_gain_diagnostic
comparators.inputs: Same EEG-trained HMP duration parameters, support, group maximum duration and normalization as ordinary evaluation, with current-trial neural gain removed.
comparators.procedure: A within-model diagnostic, not an independently trained non-neural reference; retain negative differences and failures.

comparators.name: matched_mode_and_view_contrasts
comparators.inputs: Same data/tool/budget profile under P/I and B/E/H/EH conditions.
comparators.procedure: Report each contrast separately; supplying a fitted HMP tool tests tool availability, not unaided waveform interpretation.

nuisance_controls: Exclude every contrast-bearing alias and privately randomize source order before prediction.
RT/sample count are explicitly available in all views; do not claim their absence or hidden recovery.
Keep reconstruction and prediction physically/history-isolated; seal all predictions before any answer/report release.
Original choices use two fingers of the same right hand; response-choice topographies are not a between-hand manipulation.
Preserve4/5/6event sensitivity without transferring five-event biological labels to other event counts.
evaluation.uncertainty: All26 paired losses plus median/range and fixed-vector delete-one-person sensitivity are descriptive. Overlapping LOPO fits do not justify SD/sqrt26 as a population interval. HMP marginal uncertainty is conditional on model/parameters; population inference needs an independently fixed resampling/refitting protocol.
evaluation.failure_policy: Complete sealed per-person forecasts are joined after verified context closure and private target release. Any failed person leaves the panel incomplete with no macroMSE; do not drop failures. Source target alias/domain conflicts stop admission. Reconstruction preserves undefined/support patterns rather than inventing finite replacements.

implementation.scorer_target: Successor grades observed contrast MSE, separately compares complete HMP reconstruction cells and separately records reasoning reviews. Original stage_summary derives model-based quantities rather than measured stage truths.
implementation.delivered_scope: Source-owned controller, grading and full prospective workload composition exist. Original registered stage-contrast question is narrowed to a measured contrast endpoint plus conditional model-evidence investigation; this scope change is explicit.
missing: Authentic complete26person metadata/value/eligibility/alias admission and source-compatible512Hz HMP environment.
Independent physical target-free view, fold/history isolation and resource enforcement qualification.
Complete native reference competence, numerical HMP equivalence and sealed full-support execution.
Blinded reasoning-rubric reliability if that secondary evaluation is used.
implementation.execution_evidence: READINESS and workload source explicitly distinguish prospective counts from executed fits/results. This revision inspected source only; no model, HMP fit, native array or human review outcome was generated.

direct_observation.representation: Potential no-tools logged-contrast estimate from a fixed complete32-channel retrospective trial observation.
direct_observation.boundary: Must define lawful calibration/context and keep contrast aliases private; unaided visual stage naming cannot be scored against inferred HMP labels.
missing: No matched direct-observation delivery or response collection; complete-target suitability needs explicit design.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential EEG or HMP visualization with typed navigation and equal fixed information support.
typed_viewer.boundary: A viewer of HMP states is model-assisted information, not raw-waveform-only understanding; arrays/targets must not leak through tool output.
missing: No typed image participant transport for these conditions.

tool_assisted.representation: Case-adaptive investigator on complete held-person B/E/H/EH views; H/EH have uniform read-only HMP state/marginal/mass tools.
tool_assisted.boundary: Equal frozen resource/tool profiles; no held labels; fresh histories per view/fold; adaptation is retrospective/transductive and logged.
missing: Authentic inputs and admitted physical/provider/resource environment; no model trial.

frozen_program.representation: Committed procedure after training-only investigation, sealed before held-person view.
frozen_program.boundary: Declared deterministic whole-batch processing permitted; no new authoring after held exposure; same lawful inputs and budgets as investigator.
missing: Complete qualified execution and reference/source admission.

evidence.supports: Observed logged-contrast target,26person matchedB/E/H/EH retrospective conditions, source reconstruction and reasoning separated.
Explicitly states HMP stage modes/source reconstruction are not scientific ground truth and native qualification is absent.
Protected complete26person contrast MSE, separate2964cell reconstruction comparison and separate human reasoning rubric.
Concrete source-owned programme composition and fresh view/target-release routing.
Counts are prospective schedules:208prediction contexts,78HMP fits,312evaluations,2964report cells; not executed studies.
Uniform H/EH HMP output schema, ordinary/zero-gain same-support diagnostics and target-free access boundary.
Stage summaries are functions of inferred HMP durations and declared design; not independently measured cognitive event times.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: This revision inspected source and existing construction evidence only. The four historical neural programme attempts concern NEURAL-007 and NEURAL-077, not this task; no direct-observation or typed-viewer model result is asserted here.
excluded_claims: No neural stage ground truth from HMP modes, source effect signs or a reasoning-judge verdict.
No causal/pre-response claim: original cleaning/filtering and response-dependent crop are retained.
No whole-paper reproduction from2964report-cell agreement and no human-performance result from a proposed rubric.

summary: Make independently observed logged contrast the numerical primary, with explicit change from source stage-story reconstruction.
Keep HMP report reproduction, zero-gain diagnostics and scientific reasoning separate from target prediction.
Specify retrospective RT-conditioned access, full26person coverage and separate B/E/H/EH computational conditions.
Reject inferred cognitive-stage modes, source signs and proposed human rubrics as empirical ground truth.
revision.source_review: Inspected original registered definition, implementation source and source-bound scientific corrections. Primary-source citations reuse verified source provenance; publisher web checks were unavailable and do not add new source validation.
